title: Deepgram API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (context) (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context:field: the api_key field renamed model_revision; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context), context:host: api.deepgram.com replaced by api.example-speech.test; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context), and context:keyword: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY renamed ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context), and 1 more. Twin of "Deepgram API key (unprefixed): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
